page_title: PhpStorm: For PHP That Holds Up

summary.name: PhpStorm
summary.one_liner: JetBrains' IDE for PHP and PHP frameworks such as Laravel and Symfony, designed to work alongside coding agents.
use_cases: Running multiple coding agents on one codebase
Reviewing and testing agent-generated changes before merging
Running PHPUnit or Pest tests with a debugger
summary.what_it_does: PhpStorm is a JetBrains IDE for PHP with built-in support for Laravel, Symfony, recent PHP versions, databases, Docker, Xdebug, PHPUnit, and Pest. It also supports frontend languages such as JavaScript, TypeScript, Vue, and Tailwind CSS. The page says it can run multiple coding agents, either in the GUI or terminal, and shows which agent sessions are running, done, or waiting. Users can comment on diff lines and send them back to an agent. Its code intelligence and a built-in MCP server are described as giving agents context about usages, dependencies, and types. Agents can use the user's own API key, an existing subscription, or JetBrains AI.
notable: Built-in MCP server and bundled skills for agents
Detects locally installed coding agents and can install agents from a curated catalog
Free 30-day trial, with a perpetual fallback license after 365 days of continuous subscription
Free licenses for students, teachers, and eligible open-source projects
caveats: Subscription-based; a paid subscription is needed to keep the license active after the 30-day trial
Agents such as Claude Agent, Codex, or Junie can be used through JetBrains AI, but other providers need separate credentials
